I am currently a Master's student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania, expected to graduate in 2027. Prior to this, I completed my Bachelor's degree in Economics and Finance at The University of Hong Kong, where I graduated with a cumulative GPA of 3.99/4.3.  

I am passionate about leveraging data-driven approaches to solve complex economic and financial problems. My academic and professional experiences have equipped me with strong quantitative skills and a deep interest in applying computational methods to real-world business challenges.
